rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for something ending or for bringing a meeting, speech, or activity to an end.

example.english: We can conclude the meeting now.
example.traditional: 我哋而家可以結束會議喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 git3 cuk1 wui6 ji5 laa3

rows.note: Use this when concluding something by reasoning from evidence rather than merely guessing.

example.english: After reviewing all the evidence, we conclude that he was not telling the truth.
example.traditional: 睇晒啲證據，我哋推斷佢冇講真話。
example.jyutping: tai2 saai3 di1 zing3 geoi3 ngo5 dei6 teoi1 dyun3 keoi5 mou5 gong2 zan1 waa6

rows.note: Use this when concluding means reaching a final decision, settling what will happen or what choice to make.

example.english: After discussing it, we conclude that we will move next week.
example.traditional: 傾完之後，我哋決定下星期搬屋。
example.jyutping: king1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 haa6 sing1 kei4 bun1 uk1

rows.note: Use this when someone brings about a result or helps bring an agreement or deal into existence, rather than simply finishing it.

example.traditional: 呢單生意係佢從中促成嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 sang1 ji3 hai6 keoi5 cung4 zung1 cuk1 sing4 ge3
